articles.title: Tokenization stocks slip as SEC delay puts 'speed bump' in crypto’s Wall Street push
articles.snippet: Bullish, Coinbase, and Circle were among the names lower on Friday after the regulatory setback.

articles.title: Tokenized stock holders more than double as monthly volume surges
articles.snippet: Tokenized equities reached 1.31 million holders over the past month, as monthly transfer volume surged 179% to $23.13 billion and distributed value rose 5.9% to $2.38 billion.

articles.title: RedotPay US IPO delayed amid regulatory, legal hurdles: Report
articles.snippet: RedotPay’s US IPO has reportedly been delayed as it seeks regulatory approvals, while the company says it secured a US money transmitter license.

articles.title: Crypto payments barely register among euro area merchants, ECB finds
articles.snippet: Crypto acceptance was just 0.2% online and remained below 1% at physical points of sale, while mobile payments gained ground.
